implemented: Ruler uses native f32 coordinates, rounded ten-pixel snap threshold, native track/clip start/end order including locked tracks and first-candidate ties, with no playhead/marker targets.

Pointer/project/timeline/revision/FPS/mapping ownership and modal/hidden/detached/navigation guards cancel obsolete gestures. Own view ACKs and equivalent immutable snapshots remain valid.
